mapper.insert: insert into t_agent_session (session_id, trace_id, mode, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, created_at, last_active_at) values (#{sessionId}, #{traceId}, #{mode}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update trace_id = values(trace_id), actor_type = values(actor_type), actor_id = values(actor_id), actor_name = values(actor_name), last_active_at = now()

insert into t_agent_tool_call (trace_id, session_id, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, tool_name, tool_version, risk_level, request_summary, response_summary, status, latency_ms, confirmation_id, idempotency_key, created_at) values (#{traceId}, #{sessionId}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{toolName}, #{toolVersion}, #{riskLevel}, #{requestSummary}, #{responseSummary}, #{status}, #{latencyMs}, #{confirmationId}, #{idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select * from t_agent_tool_call where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_agent_confirmation (token, trace_id, session_id, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, tool_name, risk_level, arguments_json, title, impact, status, idempotency_key, created_at, expires_at) values (#{token}, #{traceId}, #{sessionId}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{toolName}, #{riskLevel}, #{argumentsJson}, #{title}, #{impact}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, now(), #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: select * from t_agent_confirmation where token = #{token} limit 1
mapper.update: update t_agent_confirmation set status = #{status}, tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, executed_at = now() where token = #{token} and status = 'EXECUTING'
